_comment: Provenance for this port. The private original was read, never modified; what is published is a rewrite, and copy_files records the bytes actually shipped.

source.location: private worker-bundles object store, bundle for reply-debt v0.1.0

port.shape: one standard-library Python script, a SKILL.md, a README, an example config and tests
port.principle: Nothing the original hard-coded about one person, one company or one deployment survives. Anything the script needs and cannot infer is required config, and the script refuses rather than guessing.
port.verified_before_porting: run.py was read end to end and confirmed to do real work against real data. A seeded template in the same store (`job-digest`) was read as a negative control: its run.py returns an empty success and its SKILL.md instructs the model to write plausible illustrative content. It was not ported.

note: Rewritten from a private Floom pure-script worker of the same name, v0.1.0, retrieved from the private worker-bundles store on 2026-09-17. The original run.py was read end to end first, to confirm it queries a real mailbox and filters real messages rather than drafting an illustrative digest; it does. Nothing is copied byte for byte. This is the one bundle of the three that is not credential-free: it needs a Gmail connection, stated as a prerequisite in SKILL.md and README.md rather than discovered at run time. The single hard-wired Gmail connection id became a --backend choice with the token read from the environment, and a fixture backend was added so the filters can be exercised with no mailbox and no network at all.
genericisations: the hard-coded Gmail connection id became --backend {gmail-api,composio,fixture} plus --connection-id
credentials are read from GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or COMPOSIO_API_KEY inside the backend, never passed as arguments
the recipient has no default; --send is opt-in and refuses without an address
sender, subject and phrasing filter lists and the ranking weights moved into --config
the lookback window is --days, was a constant
the personal address the digest was mailed to is gone

license.licensed_work: the complete reply-debt bundle, including this derivation record
license.note: The LICENSE bytes are the upstream Apache-2.0 text unmodified except for the appendix copyright line, and match the other bundles in this repository byte for byte. No comparative evaluation of this Skill has been run and no quality state is asserted; the package tests it ships are tests, not evals.

hash_scope: copy_files lists every file this bundle ships except DERIVATION.json, because a record cannot contain its own hash. copy_files_sha256 is the sha256 of 'path:sha256' lines in path order, one per line, each terminated by a newline.
